Election Commission Clarifies MP Dharamvira Gandhi's Name on Electoral Roll

The Election Commission of India (ECI) on Friday clarified that the name of Congress MP Dharamvira Gandhi and his family members are present on Punjab's draft electoral roll published on August 13. This statement came after Gandhi claimed his name was missing. ECI officials stated that a notice issued to Gandhi regarding his eligibility and proof of residence is a standard procedure in electoral roll revision. The notice reportedly asked Gandhi to prove his 26-year residence in the constituency.
